output.title: Refund policy — duplicate charges
output.content: Duplicate charges caused by a billing system error are refunded automatically within 5 business days. No ticket is required, but you're welcome to ask support to confirm a specific refund is in progress.

output.title: Refund policy — subscription cancellation
output.content: You can cancel your subscription at any time from Account Settings > Billing. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period. We do not issue partial refunds for unused days in the current period.

output.title: Upgrading from Free to Pro plan
output.content: Upgrade from Account Settings > Billing > Change Plan. The Pro plan is billed immediately on a prorated basis for the remainder of your current billing cycle, then at the full rate from the next cycle onward.

output.title: Exporting reports to PDF (macOS)
output.content: On macOS, the in-app 'Export to PDF' button can crash the app on some versions. Workaround: use File > Print, then choose 'Save as PDF' from the system print dialog instead of the in-app export button. A permanent fix is planned but not yet released.

output.title: Data export / GDPR requests
output.content: To request a full export of your account data for GDPR or personal record-keeping purposes, go to Account Settings > Privacy > Request Data Export. The export is prepared within 30 days and sent as a download link to your account email.

steps.rawOutput:
---

**Re: Double charge AND PDF export broken**

Thanks for reaching out. I'm happy to help with both issues.

**Regarding the double charge:**

According to our policy, duplicate charges caused by a billing system error are refunded automatically within 5 business days. Since you've reported this, the refund should already be processing. No further action is required on your end, but if you'd like me to confirm the status of your specific refund, please let me know.

**Regarding the Mac PDF export crash:**

I found a known workaround for this. Instead of using the in-app 'Export to PDF' button, try this instead:
1. Go to **File > Print**
2. In the system print dialog, choose **'Save as PDF'**

This should avoid the crash you're experiencing. We do have a permanent fix in development, though it hasn't been released yet.

Please try the Print workaround and let me know if that resolves the PDF export issue for you. If you have any questions about your refund or if the workaround doesn't work, feel free to reply.
